name: pi-cache-warmer
description: Keeps the Anthropic and OpenAI prompt cache warm across idle periods in the pi coding agent. These providers' prompt-cache TTLs are roughly 5-10 minutes: if no request reads a cached prefix within that window it expires. This extension replays the last real provider request with a minimized output-token cap shortly before the TTL would lapse, reading (and thus refreshing) the same cached prefix without spending a full turn.
